issue.title: Agile - Sprint Retro
issue.description:
## 🔧 Tech Story
As a developer,
I want to reflect on what went well and what to improve,
so that each sprint sees an improvement over the last.

logs.description: Reflection on the past sprint: What worked and why didn't, and what to change next time
logs.reflection: Mostly how the login task took double the amount of time todo because I was implementing middleware which will be used by other features; and how repo / service / controller design pattern takes longer to implement than normal mvc.
Didn't go well. Was unable to add the edit or delete features, ran into issues, create recipe tasks way longer than planned. Was unable to write my tests or work on the rapport as I would've liked.
